purpose: Renewables Obligation scheme parameters for calendar 2045 (task Y13): the scheme is closed, so the line is a declared nil.

scheme_closed.reason: The RO closed to new accreditations on 31 March 2017 and ends for all generation support on 31 March 2037; no accreditation (20 years from its effective date, capped at the scheme end) runs in calendar 2045, so no obligation is set and suppliers pay nothing.
scheme_closed.source: The Renewables Obligation Closure Order 2014 and The Renewables Obligation Order 2015 (support ends 31 March 2037); Ofgem RO register (data/market/ofgem_renewables_obligation/accredited_stations_ro_current.csv)

relief_case_source: No Exchequer relief applies to a closed scheme; the one case exists because the bill case must name its relief case.
limitations: Late ROC presentation and mutualisation after 2037 are ignored; they settle within a year or two of the scheme end.
